_comment: The calibration cv-ledger for the pillar-5 bid-methodology surface (B6 timeline). CURATED, not generated — but every row cites a committed docs/experiments/ file and carries ONLY the measured deltas from it. This is the one admissible hand-entry on the surface (per docs/pillars/pillar-5-book-methodology-plan.md §7), because these are EXPERIMENT OUTCOMES (results), not book numbers. bin/export_book_methodology.jl READS (never regenerates) this file and folds it into the payload; test_book_methodology_export.jl asserts every `doc` path exists and every `cv` is <= ENERGY_PRICES_CODE_VERSION. NO-SHIPs are listed at equal prominence with status:"no_ship" — the discipline is the point.

rows.change: regime-gated -20 EUR/MWh floor on the RES + run-of-river + deepest must-run blocks for the CONTINENTAL_SOLAR group (DE_LU/FR/PL/BE/CZ/CH) in hours whose ex-ante day-ahead solar share of forecast load >= 0.4, so the coupled clear can genuinely fall below zero.
size Day-ahead-free (FBMC) border-hours on seven accepted physical borders by trailing-366d p95 gross observed flow per 4h block, replacing the intraday-blend fallback.
availability-scaled :nuclear anchor share for France (trailing-30d fleet p95 / installed, ex-ante) — the off-peak nuclear opportunity cost.
profile-gated ex-ante import backstop + scarcity credit for interior Norway, killing dry-spring phantom-scarcity caps.
model Ukraine on the HU/SK/RO/PL-UA borders as a war-constrained scarcity buyer — import supply at 0.55x zone gas SRMC, export demand as a firm cap-priced base slice + elastic tail.
per-border mean of the load-analogue median (16 trailing-365d days nearest the delivery day's D-1 load-forecast vector) and the D-2 observed flow.

profile-gated ex-ante elastic import backstop (trailing-8-weekday demonstrated headroom, priced 1.8x gas SRMC) + Core-FBMC border drops for the low-correlation continental zones whose caps were import-starvation phantoms.

measured.note: resolved a handful of phantom-scarcity cap days per weak zone; SEE products byte-identical

rows.change: candidate: apply the negative floor without the ex-ante solar-share gate (and variants). REJECTED — manufactured phantom lows on hours the settled market did not crash.

measured.note: phantom rate too high without the ex-ante solar gate; superseded by the gated cv31 floor

rows.change: further floor-family variants. REJECTED for the same phantom-low reason; the gate, not the floor, was the missing ingredient.

measured.note: no accepted arm; motivated the ex-ante solar-share gate that shipped as cv31

rows.change: candidate: a wet-reservoir low-price regime for the Nordic zones. Measured NO-SHIP — kept visible beside the ships.

measured.note: did not clear its acceptance gate on held-out windows
